subject: Urgent: Novapulse SLA spike after quantized model rollout
messages:
From: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novapulse.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novapulse SRE <sre@novapulse.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Production: p95 spike after model v3.1q8 rollout

Hi Rishi —

We started seeing a sharp p95 latency and an uptick in 5xx errors beginning at 07:12 PDT after your team rolled out the quantized variant v3.1q8 to our production endpoint. Impact: ~20% of requests failing with 500, p95 from ~290ms -> 980ms, and throughput is dropping under load. Attached a dashboard snapshot and a couple of sample failed request IDs.

This is customer-facing (several enterprise tenants). We need a fast mitigation plan. Can you confirm whether the new quant kernels were enabled globally and whether there's a fast rollback?

Attachments: novapulse-p95-spike.png

Thanks,
Asha Mehta
Head of Platform Engineering — Novapulse
asha.mehta@novapulse.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novapulse.ai>, Novapulse SRE <sre@novapulse.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Production: p95 spike after model v3.1q8 rollout

Laura/Dev/Evelyn — forwarding urgent report from Novapulse. They started the rollout to the quant profile (v3.1q8) yesterday night via our canary pipeline; looks like the rollout continued and we now have wide exposure. Initial asks:
- Immediate triage (Dev) on kernel/host resource saturation and error taxonomy.
- Canary stop + rollback plan ready in 30m (Evelyn/Infra).
- Laura, pricing/SLA implications — we may need an executive note and credit proposal if SLA breach confirmed.

I CC'd Asha so Novapulse sees internal owners. Please use the trace link: https://console.redwood/trace/REQ-3182 and attach any kernel logs.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novapulse.ai>, Novapulse SRE <sre@novapulse.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production: p95 spike after model v3.1q8 rollout

Quick triage findings (logs attached: kernel-trace-20270512.log):
- Observed higher kernel launch latency on a subset of T4/GA100 hosts when q8 kernels are used for attention. The quantized matmul path introduces a small loop/dispatch that is adding ~200–400us per token in p99; under 95th percentile burst it amplifies due to backpressure.
- Error taxonomy: ~70% of 500s correlate with GPU OOM retries on a small fraction of hosts where memory accounting changed under q8. The rest are timeouts from the inference proxy.
- Throughput: end-to-end throughput drops ~18% on heavy input workloads when q8 is used versus baseline fp16 v3.0 for same batch sizes.

Immediate recommendation: 1) Halt global rollout, stop canary progression, 2) Roll back Novapulse endpoint to v3.0-fp16 fast path (we can flip routing in 10–12 minutes), 3) Collect failing request IDs for postmortem.

I started a targeted host drain on the affected pool; will post updated kernel traces in 20m.

—Dev
Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
dev_patel@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novapulse.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production: p95 spike after model v3.1q8 rollout

Thanks for the quick triage. Two asks from my side:
1) Please confirm rollback plan and ETA so I can brief Sales/Customer Success and prepare a credit proposal if we cross SLA thresholds.
2) Before we reintroduce any quant profile, we need a small quality audit — no more than 500 random inference comparisons (baseline v3.0 vs v3.1q8) to ensure no regressed logits/critical-safety outputs. Please dump the diffs to quality-diff-samples.csv.

Keep me posted; I will coordinate comms to account execs.

—Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novapulse.ai>, Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@novapulse.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production: p95 spike after model v3.1q8 rollout

Action plan (operational):
- 11:10 PDT: stop canary progression and mark v3.1q8 as halted for Novapulse (done).
- 11:18 PDT: switch routing for the Novapulse production alias back to v3.0-fp16 (FP path) — completed at 11:20 PDT. Observed p95 fall back to ~320ms within 6 minutes; 5xx rate dropping toward baseline.
- 11:22 PDT: rolling restart of affected hosts planned in controlled batches to clear any kernel state. Expected completion by 14:30 PDT.
- Postmortem: collect kernel traces, sample diffs (Dev), and a timeline. I will own the rollback-playbook.md and the initial RCA draft.

We should also schedule a follow-up call with Novapulse engineering to run a joint replay and validate a corrected q8 kernel before any further rollout.

—Evelyn Hart
Director, Serving Infrastructure
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@novapulse.ai>, Novapulse SRE <sre@novapulse.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: p95 spike after model v3.1q8 rollout — mitigation & next steps

Asha / team — quick update and apologies for the disruption.

What we did: we halted the canary progression and rolled Novapulse back to v3.0-fp16 at 11:18 PDT. P95 latencies returned to near-baseline within ~6 minutes and 5xx errors are trending down. Evelyn will lead the host restarts and we collected kernel traces and failure IDs.

Next steps:
- We will run a joint replay with Novapulse SRE this week to reproduce the q8 failure in a controlled environment and validate kernel fixes.
- We will run the 500-sample quality audit Laura requested; results and sample diffs will be delivered in the postmortem doc (link: https://drive.google.com/novapulse/postmortem-draft).
- If SLA breach confirmed, Laura will propose a credit and I will coordinate an executive note.

Again, sorry for the customer impact — we will share the full RCA and a corrected rollout plan before any further quantized deployments.

Attaching: rollback-playbook.md and quality-diff-samples.csv for your review.

—Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
